QuestInfo.name: The Black Mage
QuestInfo.0: Nobody's ever entered the Gate of the Present before, but it led you straight to the Black Mage!
QuestInfo.1: Nobody's ever entered the Gate of the Present before, but it led you straight to the Black Mage!\r\nHe's still sealed, but he seems so powerful. Check on the seals, but take care not to wake him.
QuestInfo.2: You've looked over the seals locking up the Black Mage.

0.0: Is that #rBlack Mage#k?! \r\nIt can't be! He's supposed to be sealed away!
0.1: But what if he's broken free somehow? This place is giving me major creeps. I'll search for a #bbroken seal somewhere#k, just in case.

yes.0: I don't want to touch something and accidentally awaken the Black Mage... I need to be careful.

no.0: It's too scary, and this is above my pay scale. I'm getting out of here.

1.0: Hey, one of the seals IS broken! \r\nWait, why does this look so familiar... Where have I seen this before?

default.0: There are other seals. I need to check them all and make sure I didn't miss anything.
